storyCards.headline: Don't Stand So Close To Me: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Police's "Don't Stand So Close To Me" reached #10 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Don't Stand So Close To Me was released in 1980.

"Don't Stand So Close To Me" by The Police.

Chart story — peaked at #10 on the Hot 100.
